text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That outing was so much fun,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's go take a breather again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
By the way... do you still have some time?
There's a place I'd really like to stop by!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I'm sorry, Trainer,
for dragging you along with me...
But thanks to you, I managed to buy it properly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The shop feels a bit mature,
so being alone makes me nervous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road had brought me to a cosmetics shop.
Picking up a small item from the new arrivals section, she—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The lip balm smelled really wonderful.
They had non-tinted ones too,
so I can easily use it every day.
choice_data_list: Was that a brand you liked?
Is that a brand you like?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not particularly attached to brand names.
I simply just wanted that specific lipstick—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! Oh right, for Trainer too...
Excuse me, would you mind coming with me
to just one more shop!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right here! Let's see...
Found it, found it, here it is!
This one just came out recently, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the direction Narita Top Road pointed,
I saw—
choice_data_list: 'Keeps sweat in check and smells fresh'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a spray used during sports and similar activities. It seems to come in two scents, so trying out a sample...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That smells lovely. Is it citrus?
It's not too sweet, just a gentle scent...
It puts my heart at ease.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is that one mint-scented? It's not too strong, very refreshing... feels like it clears the mind.
choice_data_list: Did you come to buy this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I thought you might like one too, Trainer-san!
If you don't mind, please take this present!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, n-no, that's not it!! That's not what I meant! Seriously, um, you've got it wrong!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!!
I, um, this scent, uh, Trainer, mom!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I'm sorry, that's not what I meant!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both flustered,
we decided to change locations
to calm down for the moment...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
I really didn't mean it in a weird way."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*
...The truth is,

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Both the lipstick and the spray from earlier—
my mother was the one
who blended those fragrances."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My mother is a perfumer.
She blends all kinds of essences to create fragrances as her job.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, they'll send me things
that I might find useful, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's a fragrance my mom worked so hard to create.
So I want to buy and use it myself.
That's why I go searching for it like this every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for causing a weird misunderstanding because I didn't explain things well earlier!
I was planning to buy one for myself too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if we had that,
Trainer and I could use matching ones together...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting out a breath of relief, I tell
a remorseful Narita Top Road not to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Partly as an apology,
I really want you to take this present.
I was planning on giving it to you anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Two kinds of scents...
Trainer, which one do you think is better?
choice_data_list: A soft, sweet aroma of fruit

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tell Narita Top Road that I have a feeling a gentle, soft scent would really suit her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Really? But...
I think it would look great on you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's like my tension just melts away...
It brings a feeling of relief.
...A sense of security, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(She's kind of like my mom...
If I say that out loud, will people misunderstand again?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Come on, let's go buy it before the shop closes!
Make sure you start using it tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled by the hand by Narita Top Road,
I jogged back to the shop with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that its crisp, refreshing nature
reminded me of Narita Top Road's smile,
and cheered me right up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
Ehehe... That's kind of embarrassing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and mint... Hmm, how to put it?
Trainer isn't quite as... minty, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it!! It's more like,
soft and fluffy...
Um, it's got a gentle feel to it!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it all wrong!!
I didn't mean it like that at all...
Um, Trainer... huh!? You're laughing!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the secret smile, Narita Top Road
pouted in mock annoyance, only to be
quickly caught up in the laughter as well.
